title: ChronicleVibes
tagline: Introducing ChronicleVibes, a fun tutorial for Chronicle Protocol with the goal of onboarding more developers onto web3 with familiar words. For example, in the on-chain space, the word 'vibes' has become part of our dictionary & it's important to use unique ways to communicate.
description:
This project is the education track for the Chronicles Protocol bounty, education is so important and it's important that we make tutorials approachable for all sorts of devs! The more welcoming and engaging a developer document is, the likelihood of getting more devs building increases! So I have created a fun tutorial tutorial 

In the on-chain space, the word 'vibes' has quickly become part of our dictionary. We love a vibe! On a quest to onboard more developers onto web3, I have identified that simple changes can make a difference in devs actually building, for example use of familiar words. Often times, 'newbies' turn away when they see concepts they do not understand. Hence, introducing ChronicleVibes, a fun tutorial for Chronicle Protocol.
how_its_made: As a postdoc at the University of Oxford with 4 degrees including a PhD, unique approaches to education is fully embedded into everything I do. I am passionate about education that is effective and results of people learn and at least trying in the first place. So I have created a fun tutorial for Chronicle Protocol which is suitable for those who are new to the space and potentially want to learn more without the instant fear of immediate jargon.
